author: liamjulian
body:
Hi. My username is liamjulian. I have a brother whos username is JulianZN2003. I used to play on avicus we my brother all the time until we both got banned last November. We got banned because my brother was telling people to delete system32.  
He says that in the reason he was banned it said also for hacking minecraft. He was not hacking and we dont use hacks so I dont know why they thought that. My brother was unbanned after writing after writing an appeal. I am SOO sorry about all this. I promise to never do something similar again.
